title: Postdoc in Robot Learning for Manipulation
about: Two full-time postdoctoral positions of at most two years at KTH School of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science, working on Vision-Language-Action models for tabletop, mobile or dexterous manipulation, including whole-body motion and multi-fingered hands.
requirements: Doctorate, in place by the time of the hiring decision
Experience in at least two of: deep learning, reinforcement learning, imitation learning, robot perception, navigation, grasping, dexterous or mobile manipulation

upskill.name: Robotics & Autonomous Systems I
why: "grasping, dexterous or mobile manipulation" (qualification) → "Manipulation: dexterous grasping, object interaction, learning from demonstration"
"robot perception" (qualification) → "Robot perception: sensor fusion, SLAM (simultaneous localisation and mapping)"
